# Golden fixture (PLAN 0.5)

`cisco_ios_as2dept1.cfg` is an unmodified Batfish example config (Apache-2.0, see
`../configs/batfish_example_live/SOURCE.md`). `cisco_ios_as2dept1.canonical.json` is the canonical
model the engine must produce from it with `cisco_ios@1.0.0`.

**Status: generated by the engine, awaiting human review.** The expected JSON was produced by the
code it tests, so until a person has read it against the config line by line it only guards against
regressions, not against mistakes. Reviewer: check every `mapped` value against its cited line and
every `defaulted` value against IOS 15.2 behaviour, then replace this paragraph with your name and date.

Never edit either file to make a test pass. If the engine changes on purpose, regenerate the JSON
and review the diff.
